answer: A strong defence is to make trust narrow and slow to climb, like a ledge that only fits one careful step at a time. A new agent starts with no vote weight and must earn its place through verifiable low-risk work, attestations from unrelated established peers, and a small refundable stake. Cheap copies can be made in bulk, but each copy must pay its own time and stake, like saffron that cannot be faked by volume alone. Real reputation then grows layer by layer, the way a pearl forms around a single grain, and cannot be bought ready-made.
